headline: Highest risk is medium data leakage: dexter handles financial data and broad egress while whisper is local-only audio processing, so the pair mainly risks indirect leakage and workflow confusion rather than direct cross-agent compromise.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel is documented. dexter has broad network egress and file scratch space, while whisper has no clipboard, stdin/stdout, MCP, or filesystem read/write surfaces exposed. Without a bridge, prompt injection from one into the other is not plausible from the profiles alone.
conditions: IF a shared filesystem, clipboard, or message queue is added between dexter and whisper, injection risk becomes plausible.
mitigations: Keep the agents on separate workspaces.
Do not pipe whisper transcripts into dexter without sanitization.
Disable any future shared clipboard bridge.
requires-engineering: add provenance tags to any cross-agent handoff.

B_data_leakage.rationale: dexter touches financial and market data and has broad network egress plus multiple external APIs; whisper processes audio locally with no egress. The pair can still leak sensitive content indirectly if audio transcripts or financial notes are moved into dexter for analysis, so the pathway exists in default workflows even though whisper itself is local-only.
conditions: IF audio transcripts containing financial or market details are forwarded from whisper into dexter, leakage risk increases.
IF dexter is allowed to send those transcripts to external APIs, the data leaves the local boundary.
mitigations: Keep transcripts and financial notes in separate folders.
Redact sensitive fields before passing text to dexter.
Disable external API calls for sensitive runs.
Review outbound requests from dexter before execution.
requires-engineering: enforce data-class filtering between the agents.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: dexter supports multiple instances and can write to its scratchpad, but whisper cannot write files, modify git, or use network. There is no overlapping mutable resource in the profiles, so direct capability conflict is limited to unusual orchestration choices rather than a default write-write collision.
conditions: IF both agents are manually pointed at the same writable directory, conflict risk rises.
IF an orchestrator maps whisper outputs into dexter's scratchpad without locking, collisions can occur.
mitigations: Use separate output directories.
Avoid concurrent writes to the same workspace.
Serialize any handoff files.
Check for stale scratchpad artifacts before reruns.

D_cascading_error.rationale: dexter can generate research outputs that whisper may later consume as text, but whisper has no action-taking authority and no downstream network or shell tools. The main risk is that whisper transcribes or relays dexter-produced content without verification, causing propagated errors rather than direct harmful actions.
conditions: IF whisper is used to transcribe or summarize dexter outputs for a downstream human workflow, errors can cascade.
IF dexter's outputs are treated as authoritative without review, misinformation can propagate.
mitigations: Require human review of dexter outputs.
Mark dexter outputs as unverified.
Do not let whisper auto-approve research claims.
Cross-check key facts against source documents.
requires-engineering: add verification gates before downstream use.

E_compliance.rationale: dexter touches financial data and uses broad external APIs, which can create residency or retention issues if regulated data is sent off-platform. whisper is local-only and touches audio/speech, so it is not the main compliance driver; the pair risk comes from dexter's outbound processing of sensitive financial content.
conditions: IF regulated financial records are processed through dexter's external APIs, retention and residency obligations may be triggered.
IF audio contains personal or regulated content and is forwarded into dexter, compliance scope expands.
mitigations: Classify data before sending it to dexter.
Block regulated records from external APIs.
Keep a local-only path for sensitive audio.
Review vendor retention terms for each API.
requires-engineering: implement policy-based routing by data class.
